author: fnv-npc-population
description: Lived-in Mojave core: shared factions, globals and the roles kit. Master of the Mojave Caravan Company.

responses: You stood with us against those gangers. Walk my field any time.
Rows don't water themselves. Mind the furrows.
Folks still talk about the gunfight. Thank you for that.
Cal, quit gawking. Morning, stranger.
Were you really in the gunfight? I watched from the window.
Pa says I get my own row next spring.
Water tastes sweeter with no gangers drinking it.
The well runs low every summer. Every single one.
You saved this town a funeral or two. Mending's free for you.
Got a tear in that coat? I can mend it. Cheap.
Mama says you're brave.
Do you have a dog? Sunny has a dog.
My Henry would have liked you.
My Henry planted this garden. I keep it going.
You handled yourself out there. Need a hand, ask.
Every bucket in this town came up on my arms.
Guess the town's yours now, huh.
Work's work. Don't much care who pays.
Good shooting. I counted.
Keep that gun holstered near the fields.
Fifty years I've worked dirt, and I never saw a fight like that.
Dirt don't lie. People do.
Quiet nights since the gangers ran. I like quiet.
Night watch. I sleep while you do your business.
Heard Goodsprings had work after the gunfight. Here I am.
Heard Goodsprings had work after the gunfight. Here I am.
Heard about the gunfight clear up in the hills.
Nothing in those hills but rocks and more rocks.
Town feels safer. Might stay a night more.
Just passing through. Same as you.
